import { useState } from "react";

const BLUSH = "#fde8e0";
const ROSE = "#b5706a";
const MAUVE = "#8c5a5a";
const DARK = "#4a3030";
const WHITE = "#fffaf8";
const GOLD = "#c9a96e";

const FLOWERS = "data:image/png;base64,";

const labelStyle = (focused, name) => ({
  display: "block",
  fontFamily: "'Josefin Sans', sans-serif",
  fontSize: "0.7rem",
  letterSpacing: "0.15em",
  textTransform: "uppercase",
  color: focused === name ? ROSE : MAUVE,
  marginBottom: "5px",
  fontWeight: 600,
  transition: "color 0.2s",
});

const inputStyle = (focused, name) => ({
  width: "100%",
  padding: "10px 14px",
  borderRadius: "0",
  border: "none",
  borderBottom: `1.5px solid ${focused === name ? ROSE : "#d4b8b0"}`,
  background: "transparent",
  fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif",
  fontSize: "1.05rem",
  color: DARK,
  outline: "none",
  boxSizing: "border-box",
  transition: "border 0.2s",
});

export default function RecipeSubmission() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "", relationship: "", recipeName: "",
    servings: "", prepTime: "", ingredients: "", instructions: "", note: "",
  });
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("idle");
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(null);

  const handleChange = (e) => setForm({ ...form, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  const canSubmit = form.recipeName && form.ingredients && form.instructions && status !== "submitting";

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!canSubmit) return;
    setStatus("success");
  };

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Josefin+Sans:wght@300;400;600&display=swap');
        @keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(24px);} to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} }
        @keyframes popIn { 0%{transform:scale(0.8);opacity:0;} 70%{transform:scale(1.05);} 100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;} }
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        textarea { resize: vertical; }
        ::placeholder { color: #c4a0a0; opacity:1; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; }
      `}</style>

      <div style={{
        minHeight: "100vh",
        background: BLUSH,
        display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", justifyContent: "center",
        padding: "0 16px 48px",
        position: "relative", overflow: "hidden",
        fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif",
      }}>

        {/* Flower image top */}
        <img src={FLOWERS} alt="" style={{
          position: "fixed", top: "-30px", left: "50%",
          transform: "translateX(-50%)",
          width: "100%", maxWidth: "700px",
          opacity: 0.18, pointerEvents: "none", userSelect: "none",
          zIndex: 0,
        }} />

        {/* Flower image bottom */}
        <img src={FLOWERS} alt="" style={{
          position: "fixed", bottom: "-30px", left: "50%",
          transform: "translateX(-50%) scaleX(-1) scaleY(-1)",
          width: "100%", maxWidth: "700px",
          opacity: 0.13, pointerEvents: "none", userSelect: "none",
          zIndex: 0,
        }} />

        {status === "idle" && (
          <div style={{
            width: "100%", maxWidth: "500px", position: "relative", zIndex: 1,
            animation: "fadeInUp 0.7s ease both",
            paddingTop: "40px",
          }}>
            {/* Header card */}
            <div style={{
              background: WHITE,
              borderRadius: "2px",
              boxShadow: "0 4px 30px rgba(100,50,50,0.1)",
              padding: "40px 36px 36px",
              border: `1px solid #e8cfc8`,
            }}>
              {/* Gold top line */}
              <div style={{ width: "60px", height: "2px", background: GOLD, margin: "0 auto 20px" }} />

              <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: "28px" }}>
                <p style={{ fontFamily: "'Josefin Sans', sans-serif", fontSize: "0.65rem", letterSpacing: "0.25em", color: ROSE, textTransform: "uppercase", margin: "0 0 8px" }}>
                  Bridal Shower
                </p>
                <h1 style={{
                  fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif",
                  fontSize: "2.6rem", fontWeight: 300,
                  color: DARK, margin: "0 0 6px", lineHeight: 1.1,
                  fontStyle: "italic",
                }}>
                  Share a Recipe
                </h1>
                <p style={{ fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif", fontSize: "1.1rem", color: MAUVE, margin: "6px 0 0", fontStyle: "italic", fontWeight: 300 }}>
                  for our lovely bride, Ximena
                </p>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "12px", margin: "18px 0 0", justifyContent: "center" }}>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, height: "1px", background: `linear-gradient(to right, transparent, ${GOLD})` }} />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: "1rem" }}>🌸</span>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, height: "1px", background: `linear-gradient(to left, transparent, ${GOLD})` }} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "22px" }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "20px" }}>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(focused, "name")}>Your Name</label>
                    <input name="name" value={form.name} onChange={handleChange}
                      onFocus={() => setFocused("name")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                      placeholder="Jane Smith" style={inputStyle(focused, "name")} />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(focused, "relationship")}>Relationship</label>
                    <input name="relationship" value={form.relationship} onChange={handleChange}
                      onFocus={() => setFocused("relationship")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                      placeholder="Friend, Aunt…" style={inputStyle(focused, "relationship")} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(focused, "recipeName")}>Recipe Name</label>
                  <input name="recipeName" value={form.recipeName} onChange={handleChange}
                    onFocus={() => setFocused("recipeName")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                    placeholder="Grandma's Lemon Cake…" style={inputStyle(focused, "recipeName")} />
                </div>

                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "20px" }}>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(focused, "servings")}>Servings</label>
                    <input name="servings" value={form.servings} onChange={handleChange}
                      onFocus={() => setFocused("servings")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                      placeholder="4–6" style={inputStyle(focused, "servings")} />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(focused, "prepTime")}>Prep Time</label>
                    <input name="prepTime" value={form.prepTime} onChange={handleChange}
                      onFocus={() => setFocused("prepTime")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                      placeholder="30 mins" style={inputStyle(focused, "prepTime")} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(focused, "ingredients")}>Ingredients</label>
                  <textarea name="ingredients" value={form.ingredients} onChange={handleChange}
                    onFocus={() => setFocused("ingredients")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                    placeholder={"1 cup flour\n2 eggs\n…"} rows={4}
                    style={{ ...inputStyle(focused, "ingredients"), lineHeight: 1.7 }} />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(focused, "instructions")}>Instructions</label>
                  <textarea name="instructions" value={form.instructions} onChange={handleChange}
                    onFocus={() => setFocused("instructions")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                    placeholder={"Step 1: Preheat oven to 350°F\nStep 2: …"} rows={5}
                    style={{ ...inputStyle(focused, "instructions"), lineHeight: 1.7 }} />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(focused, "note")}>A Note for Ximena</label>
                  <textarea name="note" value={form.note} onChange={handleChange}
                    onFocus={() => setFocused("note")} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)}
                    placeholder="Why this recipe is special…" rows={3}
                    style={{ ...inputStyle(focused, "note"), lineHeight: 1.7 }} />
                </div>

                <div style={{ textAlign: "center", paddingTop: "8px" }}>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "12px", marginBottom: "20px" }}>
                    <div style={{ flex: 1, height: "1px", background: `linear-gradient(to right, transparent, ${GOLD})` }} />
                    <span style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>🍃</span>
                    <div style={{ flex: 1, height: "1px", background: `linear-gradient(to left, transparent, ${GOLD})` }} />
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={!canSubmit} style={{
                    padding: "14px 40px",
                    background: canSubmit ? ROSE : "#d4b0ac",
                    color: WHITE,
                    border: "none",
                    borderRadius: "1px",
                    fontFamily: "'Josefin Sans', sans-serif",
                    fontSize: "0.7rem",
                    letterSpacing: "0.2em",
                    textTransform: "uppercase",
                    cursor: canSubmit ? "pointer" : "not-allowed",
                    transition: "background 0.2s, transform 0.1s",
                    fontWeight: 600,
                  }}>
                    Submit My Recipe
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Gold bottom line */}
              <div style={{ width: "60px", height: "2px", background: GOLD, margin: "28px auto 0" }} />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {status === "success" && (
          <div style={{
            width: "100%", maxWidth: "440px", position: "relative", zIndex: 1,
            paddingTop: "80px", textAlign: "center",
            animation: "popIn 0.6s ease both",
          }}>
            <div style={{
              background: WHITE, borderRadius: "2px",
              boxShadow: "0 4px 30px rgba(100,50,50,0.1)",
              padding: "52px 40px", border: `1px solid #e8cfc8`,
            }}>
              <div style={{ width: "60px", height: "2px", background: GOLD, margin: "0 auto 28px" }} />
              <p style={{ fontFamily: "'Josefin Sans', sans-serif", fontSize: "0.65rem", letterSpacing: "0.25em", color: ROSE, textTransform: "uppercase", margin: "0 0 10px" }}>
                Thank You
              </p>
              <h2 style={{ fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif", fontSize: "2.4rem", fontWeight: 300, fontStyle: "italic", color: DARK, margin: "0 0 16px" }}>
                {form.name ? form.name : "Dear Friend"}
              </h2>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif", fontSize: "1.15rem", color: MAUVE, lineHeight: 1.8, margin: "0 0 24px", fontWeight: 300 }}>
                Your recipe for <em style={{ color: ROSE }}>{form.recipeName}</em> has been received. Ximena is going to cherish it. 🌸
              </p>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "12px", margin: "0 0 28px" }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, height: "1px", background: `linear-gradient(to right, transparent, ${GOLD})` }} />
                <span style={{ fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>🌼</span>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, height: "1px", background: `linear-gradient(to left, transparent, ${GOLD})` }} />
              </div>
              <p style={{ fontFamily: "'Josefin Sans', sans-serif", fontSize: "0.65rem", letterSpacing: "0.15em", color: "#b89898", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>
                This recipe will be part of something special
              </p>
              <div style={{ width: "60px", height: "2px", background: GOLD, margin: "24px auto 0" }} />
              <button onClick={() => { setForm({ name:"",relationship:"",recipeName:"",servings:"",prepTime:"",ingredients:"",instructions:"",note:"" }); setStatus("idle"); }}
                style={{
                  marginTop: "24px", padding: "10px 28px",
                  background: "transparent", color: ROSE,
                  border: `1px solid ${ROSE}`, borderRadius: "1px",
                  fontFamily: "'Josefin Sans', sans-serif", fontSize: "0.65rem",
                  letterSpacing: "0.2em", textTransform: "uppercase", cursor: "pointer",
                }}>
                Submit Another
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
